nodes.notes: Enable ONLY during the 14-day parallel-run window (T+0 to T+14d). Disable on Day 15 when Phase B begins.

nodes.name: HTTP: Pull Zapier task history (last hour)

parameters.query:
SELECT Idempotency_Hash__c, External_Submission_Id__c, Source__c, Status__c, n8n_Execution_Id__c, Received_At__c
FROM Lead_Inbound_Log__c
WHERE Received_At__c >= LAST_N_HOURS:1
ORDER BY Received_At__c ASC
